title: Generate stable IDs from signatures so same entity always gets same ID

title: Compute geometry signatures (length, angle, perimeter) that survive re-export
description: AUDIT FINDING: matcher.py _fingerprint() is sha256(type|layer|points|text|block_name). This is fragile — any point noise breaks hash. No geometric features used. Gap: a LINE moved 0.00001" gets completely different fingerprint. ACTION: Implement richer signatures that tolerate noise. LINE: length + angle_bucket(5°) + midpoint_bucket(0.25"). LWPOLYLINE: vertex_count + perimeter + turn_angle_sequence_hash. INSERT: block_name + attrib_tags + insertion_point_bucket + rotation_bucket. Store as GeometrySignature dataclass. Deps: E1.B3. Tests: property tests — small noise (±0.001") doesn't change signature, large changes (>tolerance) do.
